name: mini-coding-agent
description: A local conversational AI coding agent CLI.

scripts.check:bench: node dist/cli/index.js bench run benchmarks/agent-bench-v1.json --baseline benchmarks/baselines/core-v1.json
scripts.build: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs
scripts.bench: node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs && node dist/cli/index.js bench run benchmarks/agent-bench-v1.json --baseline benchmarks/baselines/core-v1.json
scripts.verify: node scripts/check-architecture.mjs && node scripts/check-exports.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs && node scripts/check-cli-entry.mjs && node dist/cli/index.js bench run benchmarks/agent-bench-v1.json --baseline benchmarks/baselines/core-v1.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters && vitest run
scripts.verify:regression: node scripts/check-architecture.mjs && node scripts/check-exports.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/clean.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/finalize-build.mjs && node scripts/check-cli-entry.mjs && vitest run tests/cli-regression.test.ts tests/cli-real-api-regressions.test.ts
